content:
TEMPTATION ||| Tilt my head closer, brushing against his arm ||| "You think they can see how much I want you?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, keeping the blade steady between us ||| "I need to focus on what this means for everyone here."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, letting my breath hitch ||| "I can't stop thinking about how you see me."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade firmly, challenging his presence ||| "I control this moment now; you'll answer me first."  
SILENCE ||| Tighten my grip, staring at the blade in my hands ||| *A breath, heavy and filled with tension.*
